lines.text: Ahaz became king at twenty, reigned sixteen years, made cast images of the Baals, and sacrificed his sons in the fire.
The LORD delivered Ahaz to Aram, whose king took captives to Nineveh, and Pekah killed 120,000 valiant men in Judah.
Israelites took 200,000 captives and plunder to Samaria, but the prophet Oded told them to return the captives.
The armed men left the captives and plunder, and designated men clothed them and brought them to Hebron.
Ahaz cut up the articles of God's house and shut its doors, and he was not buried in the kings' tombs.
